notes.title: Update 0.0.7
notes.content:
-Repaired Save/Load System(Currency and Inventory).
-Repaired User Interface on ESC.
-Transport Jobs now pickable on Billboards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135230/01d2a1f9a9eb92c47fb113f49c397a8e64dcfa0a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135230/a73f0abc0162faede8d5e59ee9ddd47c7d28c818.jpg[/img]
-Reworked transport roads to Reactor.
-Added detachable parts to Gaz.
-Added Speedmeter to Gaz and Mini Tractor.

-Added 15 new missions for Gaz Transporter.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135230/8daaf27ab58e28239d6e4ab1d7c12218370d0efa.jpg[/img]

-Reduced Memory usage (RAM) by almost a half.
-Reworked many little Bugs.

notes.content:

-Fixed Players position after save
-Fixed all missions,removed Dimitry 2,missions trigger now on Dimitry 1
-Vegetables can now get abandoned
-Added new working tool(Scythe)
-Save/Load game works now better but is still not perfect.Be sure to save your game at least two times

-Inventory is linked now to a Bagpack

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed Log/Half Log issues on equip.

-Fixed double count of Foods and Drinks.

-Removed switch cameras on Enter/Exit shops and gas stations.

-Add info on waterpump to show how to use.

-Repaired small and big Porch for houses.

-Player can die now when health is 0.

-Added Gun/Ammo Seller on Shooting Range.

-Removed Car Repair to rework

More to come ......
